content:
All 12 players’ scores sum to 100.  
Each score is even and at least 7, so the minimum possible score is 8.

To maximize one player’s score, give the other 11 players the minimum:

\[
11 \times 8 = 88
\]

So the maximum possible score for one player is:

\[
100 - 88 = 12
\]

This is even and at least 7, so it is valid.

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
